name: Extract structured data from text (AI)
description: Posts incoming free text (an email, a note, a pasted receipt) to a webhook; Claude turns it into structured rows; parse_json reads the model's JSON — stripping any Markdown code fence automatically — and the rows land in the built-in store. The classic 'messy text in, clean table out' pattern. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as a secret.

params.system: Extract every line item from the user's text as a JSON array of objects with the fields "description" (string) and "amount" (number). Reply with only the JSON array, no prose.
